scarpside_turf.bias_notes: Anti-clockwise (left-handed). The outer, sprawling Scarpside circuit featuring the longest home straight in Western Australia (456 metres). The broad 24m wide track, cambered turns, and long straightaway make it one of the fairest galloping surfaces in Australia. Sweeping closers ('Swoopers') and off-pace pressers ('P') get every opportunity to wind up and catch leaders.
scarpside_turf.post_bias: Extremely fair course. Long backstretch runs in 1300m, 1400m, 1600m, and 1800m routes ensure that outside barriers (stalls 8+) are non-detrimental, as jockeys have ample time to find cover without burning early energy.

handicapping_angles.scarpside_456m_swooper_upgrade: On the Scarpside course, aggressively upgrade strong L400m closers ('Swoopers') and well-balanced stalkers ('P'). One-dimensional front-runners ('Need-the-Lead' types) who rely on tight turns frequently hit the wall over the final 150 metres.
handicapping_angles.perth_metro_shipper_class_edge: Pinjarra Scarpside regularly hosts premier Perth Metropolitan alternate meetings. Top Perth yards (Adam Durrant, Neville Parnham, Grant & Alana Williams, Simon Miller) send high-grade runners here. Upgrade horses dropping out of Ascot or Belmont Saturday metro company (+3.0 pts).
handicapping_angles.pinjarra_cup_carnival: During the Pinjarra Cup ($150k+ Listed) & Magic Millions WA feature meeting, race class elevates to Listed/Group grade. Factor in higher speed par offsets for feature races.

par_adjustment.tier: Tier 2 (WA Premier Metro Alternate / Scarpside HQ)
